mentions.name: Spill
mentions.description: This is a modern torrent client that provides a daemon and web UI out of the box, and also ships an embeddable BitTorrent engine for use in any Rust application. It is already usable for most scenarios.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on a modern implementation of a torrent client [1], it's already pretty usable for most scenarios. Provides both a daemon + web UI out of the box as well as an embeddable engine for any Rust application.
mentions.author: yuvadam
